claim_text: Multivitamin/mineral products vary substantially in composition; when a person already uses one, the amounts of relevant vitamins and minerals from that product must be included before recommending additional supplements.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent duplicate supplementation and unsupported wellness claims; support safe total-intake assessment.

population.other_context: People already taking a multivitamin/mineral product.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify exact product label and formulation.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Multivitamin/mineral Supplements fact sheet describes variability in product composition and the need to consider total nutrient intake.
limitations: No additional dose can be inferred without the exact product label and user context.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
